title: Taiwanese Heritage Society of Houston 台灣人傳統基金會
content_html:
The Taiwanese Heritage Society of Houston (THSH) is an IRS 501(c)(3) non-profit organization based in southwest Houston, Texas, dedicated to providing community services and promoting Taiwanese culture and heritage in the greater Houston area. It owns and operates the Taiwanese Community Center (TCC), a 15,000-square-foot facility on a two-acre lot at 5885 Point West Drive that has served as the home of Houston’s Taiwanese American community since opening in 1992.

The TCC facility includes a 4,000-square-foot grand hall, a dance studio, eight classrooms, a Taiwanese culture library, a general library, a computer room, a kitchen, a conference room, a children’s playground, and parking for 90 cars. Programming spans all age groups: the Houston Taiwanese School of Languages and Culture holds weekend classes for children in Taiwanese, Mandarin, English, mathematics, and cultural subjects; adult continuing education includes computer workshops and fitness activities; and a senior program provides a regular gathering space for exercise, learning, and social connection. In 1999, THSH established a Community Service Committee to expand its outreach, and the organization has since participated in events including the Asian American Festival, sky lantern and kite activities, and a Taiwanese Culture and Arts Fair. THSH also administers scholarship programs for students and offers outreach through the Houston Museum of Natural Science and citizenship assistance programs.
